test_title: PYST 5: SSC JE EE- General Intelligence (Held On 10 Oct 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: R is son of P. Q is mother of N. M is husband of N. M is R’s sister’s husband. If O is the son of N, then how is P related to O?
solution:
Preparing the family tree diagram by using the following symbols:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4d9bbeaae5e810428e48ee0f1f99cc338ea7b12fc0e65e510308f0ecea9ac1bc.png] 

As per the given information:

1. R is the son of P.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9a6208bedd38875278ecf6fa4321cabebd13135986f57be890d5bda30e79a3eb.png] 

2. Q is the mother of N and M is the husband of N.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/350433532def0143b55456b1be8255c67951d3eea11a6a8447204e5987b66d0d.png] 

3. M is the R’s sister’s husband and O is the son of N.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e45b66671a34aba6b2f80ea1a944f4f6949fac7bc6d07bded23b6e86543e8063.png] 

Here, P is the **mother's father** of 'O'.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (4)".
